skill_name: Given an ingredient, suggest a recipe.
workflow: A recipe that could be made with coconut include Coconut Curry Soup. This recipe requires 1 tablespoon of coconut oil, 1 onion diced, 1 teaspoon of curry powder, 1 garlic clove minced, 1 can of coconut milk, 1 vegetable stock cube, 2 potatoes diced, 2 carrots diced, 1 teaspoon of chili flakes, and 1 handful of fresh coriander. Heat the coconut oil and add the onion, garlic, and curry powder. Cook for 2 minutes. Add in the coconut milk, vegetable stock cube, potatoes, and carrots. Simmer for 15 m
